likelyCauses.tr: Event ID 1074 planli yeniden baslatma/kapatma olabilir; Windows Update veya TrustedInstaller sik gorulur.
likelyCauses.en: Event ID 1074 may indicate a planned restart/shutdown; Windows Update or TrustedInstaller is common.

verificationChecks.tr: User32 kaynagini, Windows Update gecmisini ve ayni zaman diliminde Event 6008 ile 41 kayitlarini kontrol et.
verificationChecks.en: Check User32 source, Windows Update history, and nearby Event 6008 and 41 entries.

expertTips.tr: 1074 tek basina beklenen kapanma demektir; beklenmeyen kapanma icin 6008 ve 41 ile capraz kontrol yap.
expertTips.en: 1074 alone means planned shutdown; cross-check 6008 and 41 for unexpected shutdowns.

likelyCauses.tr: Event ID 6008 beklenmeyen kapanmayi gosterir; guc kesintisi, crash veya forced reset olabilir.
likelyCauses.en: Event ID 6008 indicates unexpected shutdown; power loss, crash, or forced reset are possible.

verificationChecks.tr: Ayni oturumda Event 41, guc kaynagi ve disk/driver hatalarini kontrol et.
verificationChecks.en: Check Event 41, power source, and disk/driver errors in the same session.

likelyCauses.tr: Event ID 41 sistem duzgun kapanmadan yeniden basladi; guc, driver, hardware veya freeze kaynakli olabilir.
likelyCauses.en: Event ID 41 means the system restarted without a clean shutdown; power, driver, hardware, or freeze may be involved.

troubleshootingSteps.tr: Bug Check kodu, mini dump, guc kablosu/UPS ve son driver degisikliklerini incele.
troubleshootingSteps.en: Review bug check code, mini dump, power cable/UPS, and recent driver changes.
